metadata.creator: Hiax36
metadata.description:
A Python script that generates a path between areas for the SM64 ROM Hack B3313, using the official wiki (b3313.info) as a base. The github for it was seemingly taken down for unknown reasons.

NOTE: After generating a map, you may need to restart the script with Ctrl + C, then answering with n when prompted to generate the map.
NOTE 2: Alternate names for areas seem to not work.

The script requires some Python modules, which are:
networkx
nx
regex
pylablib
bs4
requests
dijkstar
random
pathlib
